Hello! I am a Master's student in Public Health - Statistics, Modelling, and Health Data Science (SMSDS) at Sorbonne Université.

I am also an active member of MIDVIE, a Vietnamese infectious disease mathematical modelling community established through a collaboration between the Oxford University Clinical Research Unit (OUCRU) and the Ho Chi Minh City Center for Disease Control (HCDC).

When I’m not digging into data or models, you’ll probably find me at the gym, in the pool, or out training for a triathlon.

## Research Interest

My research focuses on **causal inference** and **mathematical modelling**. My current work concentrates on causal inference methods, confounding control, and infectious disease dynamics.

## Education

- Master 2 in Public Health in Statistics, Modelling and Health Data Science, Sorbonne Univerisity
- Master 1 in Public Health, Univerisity Paris-Saclay
- Bachelor in Public Health, Univerisity of Medicine and Pharmacy at Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

## Experience

- Intern, EPILOGY Team at University Paris-Est Creteil
- Research Assistant, Mathematical Modelling Group, Oxford University Clinical Research Unit
- Research Assistant, Departments of Internal and General Medicine, University of Medicine and Pharmacy at HCMC
- Youth Science Ambassador, Public Engagement & Communication Group, Oxford University Clinical Research Unit
